asset.name: CapEx request approval
asset.description: A capital request from the CapEx request form: thresholds and category rules (decision tables) choose the approvers, the budget line is checked, specialist reviews run in parallel, finance and executives approve by amount, then the budget is committed, the planned spend phased, an approval summary PDF filed and procurement raises the purchase order.

column_values.title: {{form.title}}
column_values.payback_band: {{=IF(IS_EMPTY(form.payback_years), "Not within the projection", IF(form.payback_years < 2, "Under 2 years", IF(form.payback_years < 3, "2 to 3 years", IF(form.payback_years < 4, "3 to 4 years", "4 years or more"))))}}
